svg.title: CareConnect - Map
svg.desc: One of exactly six screen designs. All shown names, records, amounts and chart values are illustrative layout data. Reference style: white header, teal navigation, pale background and rounded cards.
svg.text: Choose a patient origin. Results within 5 km update without reloading the page.
You can also click the map to choose an origin.
Illustrative basemap · markers are layout examples
New matching pings appear on the next poll.
